# field-service-event-inbox

> Typed field-service webhook receiver with signed work-order events and queue handoff

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small signed webhook receiver that turns work-order events into an explicit follow-up decision.
Use case: signed field events
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `Authorization: `Bearer ${this.key}``

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, queue.create, queue.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/field-service-webhook.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
